comment: No source is published; the maker's manual is at factionoptions.com/manual. The module declares no parameters, inputs or outputs. The page names are the module's own, and differ from the manual, which calls them Scope Strips, Scope Overlay, Scope Quad and Net CV Metrics. Paging is done by PageButton::onButton, a plain widget rather than a parameter, so no click on it reaches this feature.
